references.text: It resembles John the Baptist's call to repentance in Matthew 3:2, marking the beginning of Jesus' public ministry with a similar message.
After John was imprisoned, Jesus took up the same message as John about repentance because the kingdom of heaven is near, which binds their proclamations together.
Daniel prophesies about God's kingdom that will be established and never destroyed, which can be seen in light of John's message about the nearness of the kingdom of heaven.
The prophecy of one crying out in the wilderness to prepare the way for the Lord, which John the Baptist fulfills and introduces with his message in Matthew 3:2.
